node: Nuclear fuel cycle, HALEU, reactor components, licensing, and EPC execution
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the nuclear fuel and reactor supply-chain node found a two-lane universe: Centrus as the most direct public HALEU/fuel-cycle reference name, and three underfollowed or second-order candidates tied to isotope/enrichment optionality, reactor safety/monitoring gates, and certified nuclear components. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. The main chokepoint logic is that advanced nuclear demand from AI/data-center firm-power narratives may bottleneck not only at reactor developers and utilities, but at enriched fuel availability, qualified radiation-safety instrumentation, nuclear QA/certification, and high-reliability reactor components.
